title: Doses given abroad count toward the home schedule
description: Once a foreign dose is verified and imported, the home country's schedule counts it, so the next due doses are worked out from the child's whole history.

statements.label: Imported doses are counted
statements.requirement: Evaluating a child's schedule SHALL count verified doses imported from another country as given, by their mapped codes and dates.
statements.capability: see which doses are due once the foreign doses are counted
statements.benefit: the child gets every dose once

successCriteria.criterion: After J3's import, the infant schedule (PlanDefinition TrustDemoLaoInfantSchedule) recommends the next doses and not the birth doses already given (example ImmunizationRecommendation TrustDemoJ3Recommendation).
